note: Real ordered keystroke streams from KeyRecs (CC BY 4.0). Each person's stream is a flat array of [transitionClass, rowDistance, keyCharCode, holdMs, latencyMs] in the order typed. Hold belongs to the key, latency to the transition, so the two are looked up separately. classFactor/rowFactor carry a recorded latency onto a key pair the corpus never contains, such as digits or '@'.
